posts.text:
Pretty much everything in this piece by @sharonwaxman is either false or inaccurate, except that Paramount sources think there's a vendetta against them because of CNN. That is true, they do believe that. 

The Writers Guild is a plaintiff because of what's happening to film.
posts.summary: Critiques inaccurate reporting, defends Writers Guild lawsuit merits
